# cache_root { #labdata.config.cache_root }

```python
labdata.config.cache_root()
```

Location of the local cache.

Honours ``LABDATA_CACHE`` first and ``XDG_CACHE_HOME`` second.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Root directory of the cache, whether or not it exists.
